issues.description: 17 groups of pixel-identical images (34 rows) found in the preregistered ISIC 2019 / PAD-UFES-20 datasets, detected via bitwise-identical embedding vectors and independently confirmed via pixel-array comparison. 13/17 of these groups carry conflicting diagnostic labels for the same pixel-identical image.
issues.severity: unclassified — a property of the source data, not yet assessed for impact on any claim
issues.resolution: open — requires a PI decision before Stage 3.2+ (claim-bearing analysis) treats this as resolved one way or another

policy: Every future claim computed on this artifact should reference this register. New issues found by later audits are APPENDED as new issue_id entries, never edited into or removed from existing entries.
